name: build_minecraft_asset
description: Builds a Minecraft Bedrock .geo.json model (and optionally a procedural .png texture) from a cuboid and bone decomposition of a 2D reference image. Call it once, after the <spatial_analysis> block. Cube origins are bottom-left-front corners [minX, minY, minZ], never centers. UV coordinates are computed by the tool and must not be supplied.

asset_name.description: Lowercase snake_case asset identifier used for the geometry identifier and output file names.

format_version.description: Bedrock geometry format version. The tool always writes 1.19.0.

mode.description: block: 16x16x16 footprint, base at Y=0, hard limit 30x30x30. entity: free dimensions with a full skeletal hierarchy.

generate_texture.description: True when the command contained --texture. Every cube must then carry a material object.

visible_bounds.description: Culling bounds in block units (1 block = 16 pixels). Required for entities. Offset is the center of the bounds relative to the entity origin.

width.description: Horizontal size of the bounds in blocks.

height.description: Vertical size of the bounds in blocks.

offset.description: Center of the bounds [x, y, z] in blocks.

bones.description: Ordered bone list. Parents must be declared before their children. The first bone must be named root.

name.description: Unique bone name such as root, body, head, arm_left, leg_right, tail.

parent.description: Name of the parent bone. Omit only for root.

pivot.description: Absolute joint pivot [x, y, z] in model pixels.

rotation.description: Rest-pose bone rotation [x, y, z] in degrees.

origin.description: Bottom-left-front corner [minX, minY, minZ] in model pixels. Origin = Center - Size / 2.

size.description: Cuboid size [width, height, depth] in pixels.

pivot.description: Absolute rotation pivot [x, y, z]. Required when rotation is non-zero.

rotation.description: Cuboid rotation [x, y, z] in degrees around its pivot.

inflate.description: Uniform expansion per side in pixels. Use 0.01 or -0.01 to prevent Z-fighting.

material.description: Procedural paint instructions, required for every cube when generate_texture is true.

color.description: Dominant hex color extracted from the reference image.
